title: TRAK Ranch Volunteer
hours_note: Weekly shift commitment, 7am–11am (4 hrs) or 4pm–6pm (2 hrs); minimum 4 months
schedule_flexibility: Flexible shift choice (AM or PM), one shift per week
description: Volunteer at a therapeutic ranch for animals and kids. Help with daily animal care: feeding, mucking stalls, raking grounds, and horse handling. Horse Handler certification available for ages 12+.
requirements: Must be 10+ years old (10-11 must volunteer with parent). Complete volunteer application and orientation. Background check required if over 18. $35 orientation fee, $20 background check fee.
contact: TRAK Tucson, 3605 N. Edith Blvd, Tucson, AZ 85718

title: Virtual Volunteer Tutor
schedule_flexibility: Flexible — choose your day and time; sessions are 6-7:30pm CST weekdays or weekends
description: Tutor K-12 students one-on-one in academic subjects and mentorship. Virtual or in-person options. Program runs Mid-September through Mid-May. Training and curriculum provided.
requirements: No prior tutoring experience required. Must be 16+. Background check required. Commitment of 90 min/week for the school year.
contact: Via Tutoring Chicago volunteer application at tutoringchicago.org/volunteer

title: Miracle Friend (Phone Buddy)
schedule_flexibility: Flexible — weekly 1:1 calls/texts at your convenience; optional weekly 30-min group check-ins
description: Phone buddy program matching volunteers with individuals experiencing homelessness. Provide companionship and emotional support through weekly phone calls and texts. 100% virtual and remote.
requirements: No special skills needed. Must be willing to commit 30 minutes per week. Training provided.
contact: Via Miracle Messages volunteer portal at miraclemessages.org/friends

title: Phone Pal Volunteer
organization: Phone Pals (United Way of Southeastern Michigan)
hours_note: 1–3 times per week, 10–30 minutes per call (stacking ceiling: ~1.5 hrs, rounded to 2)
schedule_flexibility: Flexible — choose frequency and duration within the 1-3x/week range
description: Phone-based volunteer program offering companionship to isolated individuals. Volunteers call their match 1-3 times per week for 10-30 minutes each. Trainings offered monthly over Zoom.
requirements: Access to phone/computer. Willingness to make regular calls. Training provided.
contact: Via United Way of Southeastern Michigan volunteer portal
